next_question_bundle.rag_input: Does the Royal Household have to use the Sovereign Grant to manage these palaces held in trust, similar to how the Japanese government supports their current imperial properties?
next_question_bundle.question: Is the Royal Household expected to use the Sovereign Grant to maintain the occupied royal palaces held in trust by the British sovereign, in a manner comparable to how the Japanese government provides financial support for the current imperial properties?
next_question_bundle.answer: Yes, the Royal Household is expected to use the Sovereign Grant to maintain occupied royal palaces such as Buckingham Palace and Windsor Castle; similarly, the Japanese imperial family has been supported by an official civil list sanctioned by the Japanese government since the 1947 constitutional reforms.
next_question_bundle.required_new_fact_from_doc_a: Since the 1947 constitutional reforms, the imperial family has been supported by an official civil list sanctioned by the Japanese government.
next_question_bundle.required_new_fact_from_doc_b: The Royal Household is expected to use the Sovereign Grant to maintain the occupied royal palaces.
